verdict.rationale: The only retention evidence is the documentation saying OneDrive can be configured to keep file version history: a new version on each edit, on each save, manually, or never. That is a thin, product-owned retention control. Delta queries and change notifications only report deletions rather than controlling them, so they earn no credit, and community reports of lost files concern sync reliability rather than retention settings. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or durations, user- or API-driven deletion and purge controls, recycle bin and recovery-window settings, account and data deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.
